name: almanac
description: Durable project records that outlive a session: ccpraxis bug reports filed by agents working in any project (one file per report, written only through almanac-bug.pl, frozen once picked up), and the guidance notes that replace Claude Code's built-in auto-memory. Bundles /almanac:bug-report, /almanac:bug-triage, the almanac-bug.pl state machine, and a PreToolUse hook denying direct edits to report files.
